EC2: In the use of antibiotics [OR] and anti-inflammatories in the last three months;
EC3: With periodontium with periodontal parameters different from those established in the inclusion criteria.
EC4: Individuals with clinical signs of parafunctional habits;
EC6: Individuals who have performed other restorations in the last 12 months;
EC8: Periodontal sites that presented bleeding during crevicular fluid collection or sites that prevent proper collection of clinical parameters.
